summary: Verified the public Expo mobile flow and backend routes. Four backend regression tests passed; mobile welcome, demo login, menu loading, search, detail/cart, cash checkout, order tracking, profile, Google gating, and Twilio OTP gating passed.
action_items: Supply Emergent Google callback, Razorpay keys, and Twilio credentials to enable native integrations.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu loading is asynchronous; consumers/tests must wait for menu data after the menu screen appears.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from the current .env; EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not present, so keep deployment configuration aligned with this variable.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_STU12345 and TEST_NOTIFY users/orders through the existing demo login and cash-order APIs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credential-gated integrations were intentionally tested with empty credentials and returned clear 503/configuration responses. The first UI attempt checked menu items before the async GET /api/menu completed; a rerun awaiting Masala Dosa passed.
rca_of_issue: Initial apparent empty-menu failure was a test timing issue, not an application defect: GET /api/menu returned 200 and six dishes shortly afterward. Awaiting a menu item resolved it. Expo logs contain a root Electron sandbox warning for React Native DevTools, but Metro/web bundling and runtime were successful.
